objective: one logical full-scope run R7 of the candidate 1.10.0rc6 (every CSV row 0-27 as configured; not a pilot: --rows-first only orders the plan, reading rows 22, 27, 23 to 26 and 15 first, and --term-upc names the four product pages of the review; neither narrows the scope), two lanes, read in slices, each one ledger stage of the new credential's campaign oxylabs-marianos-20261116 whose ceiling is also set in the collector (set-ceiling). Every slice is ended by the operator with SIGTERM once the stage has its target of reservations (a resumable stop, exit 75); the ceiling, 10 above the target, is the backstop. Why R7: run R6 started at 23:40Z on 2026-11-16, when the site served page 1 again for 25 of 29 answers to a page 2 or later and for all 12 re-asks (measured by hour over all runs of the day: 10% at 03Z, 20-27% at 15Z, 28-34% at 16-17Z, 55-60% at 18Z, 80-86% at 23Z); a page has at most 2 re-asks in a run, so R6 was finalized offline after its first slice (rejected, never published) and R7 starts afresh in the night hours, with every page's re-asks intact. The envelope then held USD 4.7935 (3,195 submissions); a full run needs 3,145 to 3,750 submissions at F2's measured 1.43 per counted page, fewer at the night rate: if the envelope ends first, the run is left resumable after its last slice and the shortfall is reported with R7's measured rates. A short resume used only when the slice before it was stopped by the repeat-rate rule: it measures the hour again before the larger slices.

config.environment: the owner's own Azure VM (Ubuntu 24.04), PostgreSQL 16, release installed from the wheel

retry_policy: as shipped: up to 3 attempts on 408, 429 and 5xx with backoff for a first ask; a re-ask is sent once; a request set aside is asked again at most 2 more times, each at least 300 s after its previous answer or attempt; the Coupons page asked again while its list has not loaded, at most 4 answers for the run, 60 s apart (1.10.0rc6, OR-04); each submission reserved at its worst case
stop_conditions: the operator's slice target (SIGTERM: a resumable stop) before the stage's submission ceiling; the stage's submission ceiling (the collector's own ceiling and the account-wide gate); store or fulfillment not verified on a page (STORE_NOT_VERIFIED); ABNORMAL_RESULT, SITE_REFUSAL or three pages in a row not read (PROVIDER_ERROR; the collector resumes itself up to 3 times, 60 s later); a ledger refusal, or more than 2 outcomes left unknown; the stage deadline; by the operator (watch_stage.sh, counted from the slice's own start): 10 re-asks answered in the slice and none recovered its request; or 16 or more answers to a page 2 or later in the slice of which 25% or more repeat an earlier page (the share is read at the watcher's start from repeat_stop_pct, set to 25 for R7: on 2026-11-16 a quarter of such answers repeated by 15Z, and every re-ask exhausted that day was at 15-23Z; R6a's watcher had no repeat rule); either stops the stage resumably and it is reported as it stands
passes_when: the resume continues the run from its checkpoints (no completed page asked again); the slice ends with SIGTERM at 150 reservations (exit 75), or earlier by an operator rule, reported as it stands; every page verified for 53100502 PICKUP; at most 2 unknown outcomes
